verdict.rationale: Unleash's marketing claims you can "kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys," and Edge is documented as a read replica serving thousands of connected SDKs. Neither describes how changes propagate (streaming vs. polling) or how fast they reach SDKs, so only a glancing claim supports this story. Missing for 10: documented streaming or polling mechanism, stated propagation latency or polling interval, SDK-side update behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration that a kill switch takes effect within seconds.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills

citations.quote: Release, experiment, and kill anything AI ships, in real time and without redeploys.
They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.
functioning as a read replica that can handle thousands of connected SDKs without increasing the read load on your primary Unleash instance
